The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the mean score of 1.000 across trials confirms the mathematical correctness of the risk-calc, future iterations should re-check edge cases in hospital capacity thresholds to avoid potential overflow or division-by-zero errors. The results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 4m 30s runtime.
